hero:
vorkurs is a design engineering studio.
We work inside organisations to figure out what their digital products should be, then design, build and ship them in their stack, with their team.
For investment firms, climate companies and mission-driven organisations, especially when the in-house team is too small for what needs to launch.

items.heading: Consulting & Strategy
items.text: We work out what needs to happen, and what doesn’t. Goals, users, platform and how your team actually works, so you invest in the right thing and everyone knows why.

items.heading: System Design & Integration
items.text: Brand, content and digital systems that hold together in practice, not just on paper. Teams move faster, stay consistent, and change course without starting over.

items.heading: Build & Deploy
items.text: We build fast, accessible, maintainable products and put them into production: websites, design systems, internal tools, AI-assisted workflows. No fragile setups, no handing off to someone else to finish.

items.heading: Stewardship & Evolution
items.text: After launch we stay close. We watch how it’s used, improve what matters and keep the system from fragmenting, so your investment keeps paying off instead of needing a rebuild.

items.heading: Audit
items.label: Fixed scope
items.intro: For when something feels off but you're not sure what.
items.text: We look at your current setup — platform, brand, workflows — map the gaps, and give you a clear plan. Fixed fee, no commitment beyond that.

items.heading: Embedded, monthly retainer
items.label: Monthly retainer
items.intro: For teams that need someone senior inside, not alongside.
items.text: We join your team 2–3 days a week, sit with the people who use what we build, and work directly into your stack: design, engineering, or both. Most long-term partnerships start here.

items.heading: Project
items.label: End to end
items.intro: For when you need something designed, built and running.
items.text: From brief to launch and into production. Strategy, design, engineering, deployment: one team, no handoff gaps.

items.heading: Advisory
items.label: Fractional lead
items.intro: For organisations that need senior direction without a full-time hire.
items.text: We come in as a fractional lead — set the direction, define the workflow, align the team, and step back when the system runs on its own.

items.heading: citizenM
items.text:
Set creative direction across citizenM's digital ecosystem – landing pages, campaigns, CRM, web content. Built and maintained the design system in Figma: components, templates, tokens. Co-led campaigns generating 20M in revenue.

Mentored junior designers, managed external agencies, and kept the visual language consistent across 50+ properties worldwide.

items.heading: CrossBoundary
items.text:
Led the design system for one of the largest sustainable-development investment firms in the Global South. We helped envisioning the component system in Figma and built the frontend, keeping visual integrity across regions and sub-brands.

Translating complex financial content into clear, trustworthy interfaces -- with a system that scales.

items.heading: Activant Capital
items.text: Redesigned the web presence for a research-led global investment firm. Translated complex financial positioning into a clean, confident digital experience. Designed in Figma, built in code.

items.heading: Erik Kessels & Gallerie d'Italia
items.text:
Collaborated with artist Erik Kessels on Un'Immagine, a large-scale immersive installation at Gallerie d'Italia, Milan. Thousands of images from the Publifoto Archive, algorithmically stitched into a continuously moving 360-degree visual and sound experience.

Led the creative-to-technical bridge -- interpreting the artistic vision, finding the right collaborator, managing the creative dialogue, and overseeing delivery.

items.heading: Form follows function
items.text: Every decision is shaped by use, context, and accessibility. Structure comes first.

items.heading: True materials
items.text: Strategy, technology, and content that reflect reality. Built for durability, not short-term appeal.

items.heading: Systems over artifacts
items.text: We don't make one-off deliverables. We make structures that stay consistent as they grow.

items.heading: Close to the problem
items.text: We work where the work happens: with your team, your users and your real data, not from a deck at a distance.

footer.cta: Not sure where to start? Most of our clients weren’t either. [Get in touch](mailto:space@vorkurs.space).
